name: Inspiring Call buffs allies and draws a card into memory
notes: Inspiring Call's element is NORM, so no lineage patch is needed. The champion has not attacked, so the discount is unavailable and the full 3-reserve cost is paid; both players then decline the EffectStackActiveResponse opportunity window before the ability resolves. The +1 POWER buff is applied via a global effect (AddGlobalEffects), which isn't independently observable through the available assertion primitives (no live ally is on the field to check computed power against), so this fixture verifies the always-checkable half: drawing a card into memory.

rulesClauses: Draw a card into your memory.
